scope: Bounded broadcast enabling-contribution research; no article edits, outreach or programme viewing. Five candidate profiles, not a ranking or comprehensive staff history.

sources.author: Shyamanuja Das
sources.inspection: Full article inspected; relevant passage reopened. Guest column drawing on books and named interviewees. Underlying books not inspected.

claims: Places P.V. Krishnamoorthy as AIR Cuttack station director May1958–October1960.
Attributes Sugam Sangeet week and encouragement of lighter music to him, citing Akshaya Mohanty autobiography.
Describes evening meetings among musicians and lyricists; Das says Narayan Prasad Singh, Shyamamani Devi and Pranab Pattnaik told him directly about their creative importance.
limits: Attribute historical interpretation to Das; no singlehanded creation or ranking of influence.
Exact tenure presently rests on this retrospective, not personnel record.

sources.author: Fakira Mohan Nahak
sources.inspection: Full text opened; relevant technical account read.
sources.locator: lines240–241,248–255; paragraphs beginning Sanjay Pathak was heading; The live broadcast; Amitabh Bhattashali.
claims: Recalls July12,2002 Rath Yatra coverage with Puri field pictures and Hyderabad studio/control.
Names Sanjay Pathak as field-team lead, senior broadcast engineer Akshay Mohanty in charge of technical system, Amitabh Bhattashali leading Hyderabad team and Vijay Krishna handling panel production.
Nahak recalls contacting graphics staff to prepare a transition plate before switching from bulletin to live pictures.
limits: Credit distributed work and unnamed graphics/field staff; avoid solitary rescue narrative.
Engineer Akshay Mohanty is not identified as composer Akshaya Mohanty; do not merge identities.
Court/rights narrative and first-broadcast assertions not independently established here.

editorial_recommendation: Use a short connected account, not five honorary mini-biographies. The ETV episode makes institutional cooperation visible: regional production, technical field crew, Hyderabad control, graphics staff and cross-language training.
remaining_gaps: No reliable specific technical/programming contribution for Ranajit/Ranjit Mohanty at AAONXT recovered; LinkedIn search lead alone not sufficient.
Ratikanta Satpathy presumed ETV affiliation not established; do not repeat.
OTT dossier verifies founders and platform offers but does not yet provide granular non-founder technical staff credits. Do not invent them to balance media sectors.
Women and community broadcasting workers remain underrepresented in this bounded selection; this is a research gap, not evidence of their absence.
search_limits: Reused three dossiers and research query; targeted name searches and two participant retrospectives. No comprehensive employment history, personnel records or programme playback.
